steps.text: Fill a cup with whole milk and heat it in the microwave for 3-4 minutes. Stir the heated milk with a milk frother to make the cappuccino frothier.
steps.label: froth hot milk

steps.text: Take another empty cup and put 2 teaspoons of sugar and coffee in the cup. Add 2 teaspoons of water and slowly add more until the ingredients are just wet so that you can beat the mixture.
steps.label: mix coffee sugar

steps.text: Add more water if needed, whipping it vigorously with the spoon.
steps.label: whip coffee paste

steps.text: Once the mixture in nicely thickened, smooth, and almost shiny, your Indian whipped coffee is mixture is ready.
steps.label: whip until glossy

steps.text: Pour the heated milk in the golden-brown paste and stir it well until all ingredients are uniformly mixed. Heat the cappuccino again in microwave for 30 seconds and it is ready to drink.
steps.label: pour milk in coffee
